name: Ephod
overview: The ephod, as detailed in Exodus 25:7 and Exodus 28, was a sacred vestment intricately crafted for Aaron and his sons to minister as priests. Made of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, it included a breastplate attached with chains of pure gold and a blue robe, symbolizing the high priest's holy office. This garment was not only a distinctive priestly attire but also served a significant role in Israel's worship and oracle practices.
